# unifi_network_application_info (Data Source)

Detected UniFi Network application info and capabilities, from the Configure-time probe.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the detected controller version and capabilities (from the Configure-time
# probe) — useful for gating configuration on firmware support.
data "unifi_network_application_info" "this" {}

output "controller_version" {
  value = data.unifi_network_application_info.this.version
}

output "integration_writes_supported" {
  value = data.unifi_network_application_info.this.integration_writes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `integration_writes` (Boolean) Whether the firmware supports Integration API writes (version floor met).
- `site_id` (String) Integration UUID of the configured site (empty if the Integration API was unavailable).
- `version` (String) Detected Network application version (e.g. `10.4.57`).
